chunks: He has certainly power to bring him back (from the dead).
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about God's power to resurrect the dead?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *al-Raj'ah* (the Return), where a select group of believers and disbelievers are returned to the world before the final resurrection to witness the culmination of divine justice. It underscores God's omnipotence not just in initial creation, but in the precise reassembly of scattered elements, reinforcing the physical reality of the afterlife.
